question: Which team won the Irani trophy 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rest of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** The Irani Trophy:-**

 
 
• It is a domestic first-class cricket tournament in India.
 
• It is played annually between the Rest of India team, consisting of top domestic players from various states, and the Ranji Trophy champions, the winner of the premier domestic cricket competition in India.
 
 
 
• **The Rest of India team:-**
 
 
• It is also known as ROI, is a domestic cricket team in India that participates in the Irani Trophy.
 
• The Rest of India team is composed of top-performing players from various states who are not part of the Ranji Trophy-winning team.
 
• They won the Irani Trophy 2022
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Mumbai:-**

 
 
• It is one of the most successful cricket teams in Indian domestic cricket. 
 
• The Mumbai cricket team represents the Mumbai Cricket Association (MCA) and competes in various domestic tournaments, including the Ranji Trophy.
 
 
 
• **India Blue:-**
 
 
• It represents one of the cricketing regions in India and is made up of top domestic players.
 
• The team consists of players who have performed well in the domestic cricket season and are selected to represent the India Blue team.
 
 
 
• **Saurashtra:-**
 
 
• It is a cricket team that represents the Saurashtra Cricket Association (SCA) in Indian domestic cricket.
 
• Saurashtra is a region located in the western part of the Indian state of Gujarat.
